data.description: Kioxia Holdings Corp. primarily oversees and manages its various group companies, all of which operate within the memory storage sector. The corporation is also tasked with developing and implementing the overarching strategic plans for the entire enterprise. Established on March 1, 2019, its main office is located in Tokyo, Japan.
